name: NexusAdminTools
author: CS2Nexus
description: Admin powers for CS2Nexus servers: wallhack, invisibility, god mode, speed, HP and infinite money. Every command is controlled by the launcher permissions (Admins -> permissions, @nepentii/<name>). Based on CS2-AdminTools / plugin-wallhack by NeuTroNBZh and labaland (MIT).

commands.name: wh
commands.description: Wallhack: glowing outline of the enemies through walls (toggle). Permission: wh.

commands.name: invis
commands.description: Invisible: player and weapons hidden from everybody (toggle). Permission: invis.

commands.name: god
commands.description: God mode: cannot die (toggle). Permission: god.

commands.name: hp
commands.description: Set health, also above 100. Permission: hp.

commands.name: infmoney
commands.description: Infinite money, refilled after every buy, spawn and round (toggle). Permission: infmoney.

commands.name: resetall
commands.description: Remove every power from every player. Permission: resetall.

commands.name: privs
commands.description: Show the active powers of a player. Permission: privs.
